```yaml
name: Community Tests (No Secrets)

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, dev]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  PYTHONUNBUFFERED: 1

jobs:
  code_quality:
    name: Code Quality
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.12
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install Poetry
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install poetry

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          poetry install --only=dev

      - name: Validate lockfile
        run: |
          poetry lock --check

      - name: Run pre-commit hooks
        run: |
          poetry run pre-commit run --all-files

      - name: Ruff lint
        run: |
          poetry run ruff check .

      - name: Ruff format check
        run: |
          poetry run ruff format --check .

  unit_tests:
    name: Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: code_quality
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.12
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install poetry
          poetry install --only=dev

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: |
          poetry run pytest \
            tests/unit/processing \
            tests/unit/graph \
            tests/unit/chunking \
            tests/unit/retrieval \
            tests/unit/search \
            tests/unit/pipelines \
            tests/unit/visualization \
            tests/unit/ontology \
            tests/unit/permissions \
            tests/unit/cache \
            tests/unit/session \
            tests/unit/config \
            tests/unit/eval_framework \
            -q -o junit_family=xunit2 --junitxml=junit.xml

      - name: Publish test results
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        with:
          name: Unit Tests
          path: junit.xml
          reporter: junit
          list-suites: true
          list-tests: true
          max-annotations: 50
          fail-on-error: true

  cli_tests:
    name: CLI Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: code_quality
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.12
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install poetry
          poetry install --only=dev

      - name: Run CLI tests
        run: |
          poetry run pytest tests/unit/cli -q -o junit_family=xunit2 --junitxml=junit.xml

      - name: Publish CLI test results
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        with:
          name: CLI Tests
          path: junit.xml
          reporter: junit
          list-suites: true
          list-tests: true
          max-annotations: 50
          fail-on-error: true

  telemetry_tests:
    name: Telemetry Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: code_quality
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.12
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install poetry
          poetry install --only=dev

      - name: Run telemetry tests
        run: |
          poetry run pytest tests/unit/telemetry -q -o junit_family=xunit2 --junitxml=junit.xml

      - name: Publish telemetry test results
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        with:
          name: Telemetry Tests
          path: junit.xml
          reporter: junit
          list-suites: true
          list-tests: true
          max-annotations: 50
          fail-on-error: true
```
